svg.title: Support terminal request and deployment architecture
svg.desc: An approved private gateway protects the browser. The browser sends a separate demo bearer to the Next.js API. Validated requests take either explicit deterministic support replay or live tool-disabled Copilot SDK and CLI paths. Live credentials stay server-side. SSE returns a draft for duty engineer approval, not a ticket. Separately, GitHub Actions uses Azure OIDC to deploy an immutable ACR image to Container Apps with managed-identity AcrPull. Runtime Copilot and demo secrets are separate from Azure deployment credentials. Limits are process-local.
svg.text: Terminal prototype — request and credential boundaries
Approved private access gateway: organizational identity for deployed demos
Shared demo token alone is not enterprise authentication.
Browser: fiction default / Synthetic support demo button
Explicit support offline checkbox defaults true
Next.js /api/muthur: validate input + production demo bearer gate
64 KiB input + SSE output · 24 messages · 8,000 chars each / 24,000 total
4 concurrent per process · 60-second deadline · not distributed quotas
Live: SDK + locked CLI subprocess over stdio
SSE to browser: facts · unknowns · duty engineer owner · next action
Untrusted draft · human approval required · no ticket created
Container Apps secrets (not Azure OIDC credentials):
github-token → runtime Copilot; demo-access-token → browser bearer gate
